selection.multiplicity_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the run's terms (gate only)
selection.note: Two different things, and only one is corrected. Terms are ADMITTED by a Benjamini-Hochberg-corrected significance gate, but ORDERED by keyness, which carries no correction — so a high rank reflects distinctiveness and selection, not a stronger result. Treat the ordering as a reading order, not a ranking of confidence.

meta.bar_note: Each concept carries the DESIGN §3 significance bar: a cross-side difference in how a term is USED counts as a community difference only if it exceeds what a random split of the same creators produces. Every concept here cleared it — the lane annotates only terms that do, because reading thousands of candidates with an LLM is not feasible. Terms that did not clear the bar are not deleted: they remain in the candidate pool with their statistics, unannotated.
